description_en: Cancels an update operation on a stack. You can call this operation to cancel an update operation on a stack when the stack is being updated or created
description_zh: 当您的资源栈正处于更新中或创建中且操作尚未完成，您可以调用该接口取消更新资源栈操作
kebab_example: aliyun ros cancel-update-stack --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cancel-type Safe --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelUpdateStack

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The method to cancel the update operation. Valid values:

- Quick: cancels the update of a stack as soon as possible.

- Safe: cancels the update of a stack as safely as possible
parameters.help_zh:
取消更新资源栈类型。取值：

- Quick：尽快取消更新资源栈。

- Safe：尽可能安全地取消更新资源栈
parameters.name: cancel_type
